name: QTS and Lancium Hall County data center campus
summary: Lancium and QTS announced in July 2026 a data center campus near Turkey in Hall County, Texas, with more than 10 billion US dollars of planned capital investment. Lancium owns the campus and provides electrical and civil infrastructure, planning to bring its own power through battery storage and solar; QTS will design, build and operate the data center buildings. The companies said they would fund all needed energy infrastructure upgrades. Up to 7,000 construction jobs at peak and about 350 permanent jobs were projected. No capacity figure, tenant or construction dates were disclosed.

location.note: Town centroid of Turkey from Wikipedia (s2); the announcement says only that the campus is near Turkey in Hall County.

Lancium plans battery storage as part of its own power supply for the site.
Lancium and QTS will fund all energy infrastructure improvements, described as modernizing the grid for existing customers.
